components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single TAILOR action in carbon-blue.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 2px; background: #1f2f8f; color: #f8f9fa; font: 600 13px 'Public Sans', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.01em; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease, transform 120ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, #1f2f8f 88%, #171a21); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1f2f8f; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid #8a92a5; border-radius: 2px; background: #f8f9fa; color: #171a21; font: 600 12px 'Public Sans', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: #eceef2; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1f2f8f; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Boxed Field
components.description: Single-line typed field with a printed caption.
components.css: .ds-label { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; font: 700 11.5px 'Public Sans', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #171a21; } .ds-field { background: #f8f9fa; color: #1f2f8f; border: 1px solid #8a92a5; border-radius: 2px; padding: 8px 12px; font: 400 14px 'Courier Prime', 'Courier New', monospace; text-transform: none; letter-spacing: 0; transition: border-color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-field::placeholder { color: #474e60; } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #1f2f8f; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #1f2f8f; }

components.name: Typing Area
components.description: Textarea whose text sits on printed 24px rules.
components.html: <textarea class="ds-typing" rows="4">Senior engineer, 6 years of Node and React.</textarea>
components.css: .ds-typing { display: block; width: 100%; resize: none; border: 0; outline: none; background-color: transparent; background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent 0, transparent 23px, rgba(23,26,33,0.13) 23px, rgba(23,26,33,0.13) 24px); background-attachment: local; background-position: 0 4px; color: #1f2f8f; font: 400 14px/24px 'Courier Prime', 'Courier New', monospace; padding: 4px 0 0; }

components.name: Sheet with Stack
components.description: Input form on white stock with canary and rose copies peeking out behind.
components.html:
Your CV

Paste it here.
components.css: .ds-stack { position: relative; isolation: isolate; margin: 10px 10px 0 0; } .ds-stack::before, .ds-stack::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: -1; border: 1px solid #8a92a5; border-radius: 3px; } .ds-stack::before { background: #f6e78f; transform: translate(5px, -5px); } .ds-stack::after { background: #f4c1ca; transform: translate(10px, -10px); z-index: -2; } .ds-sheet { background: #f8f9fa; border: 1px solid #8a92a5; border-radius: 3px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(18,22,36,0.12), 0 16px 28px -20px rgba(18,22,36,0.4); padding: 16px 20px; color: #171a21; font: 14px 'Public Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-cap { margin: 0 0 8px; font: 700 11.5px 'Public Sans', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Choice Check Box
components.description: Printed radio check box for style and tone.
components.css: .ds-choice { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 10px; min-height: 40px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid #1f2f8f; border-radius: 2px; background: color-mix(in oklab, #1f2f8f 8%, #f8f9fa); color: #171a21; font: 600 13px 'Public Sans', sans-serif; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-choice:hover { background: #eceef2; } .ds-choice:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1f2f8f; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-box { margin-top: 3px; width: 14px; height: 14px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 1px solid #1f2f8f; border-radius: 2px; background: #1f2f8f; color: #f8f9fa; font-size: 10px; }

components.name: Fit Stamp
components.description: Rubber stamp for keyword coverage; red double rule, tilted.
components.css: .ds-stamp { display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 1px; padding: 4px 12px 5px; color: #c42b1c; background: #f8f9fa; border: 2px solid #c42b1c; outline: 1px solid #c42b1c; outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 2px; transform: rotate(-3deg); line-height: 1; text-transform: uppercase; font-family: 'Public Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-stamp-l { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.14em; } .ds-stamp-n { font-size: 28px; font-weight: 800; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Output Tabs and Copy Sheet
components.description: Each tab is a sheet edge in the same stock as its copy.
components.html: Dear hiring team,
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 2px; } .ds-tab { position: relative; top: 0; margin-bottom: -1px; padding: 8px 16px; background: #f6e78f; color: #171a21; border: 1px solid #8a92a5; border-bottom-color: #f6e78f; border-radius: 3px 3px 0 0; font: 600 13px 'Public Sans', sans-serif; z-index: 1; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab-raw { background: #f4c1ca; color: #474e60; top: 3px; border-bottom-color: #8a92a5; z-index: 0; } .ds-tab-raw:hover { color: #171a21; top: 1px; } .ds-copy { background: #f6e78f; border: 1px solid #8a92a5; border-radius: 0 3px 3px 3px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(18,22,36,0.12), 0 16px 28px -20px rgba(18,22,36,0.4); padding: 16px 20px; color: #171a21; font: 14px 'Public Sans', sans-serif; }

narrative.overview:
One application, written once, struck through to every copy. Every surface is either a ruled form (white stock with printed labels and typing lines) or a flat copy sheet of coloured stock, lying on a quiet cool-grey desk. The tool reads as paperwork you fill in and tear off, not as a dashboard or chat window. Documents are the product, so the CV and letter look like documents.

Three inks carry meaning. Printed black ink is for labels and structure. Carbon-blue is for what the applicant typed and for the single primary action. Serial red appears only on serial numbers, the fit stamp, the streaming ink dot and the "suggested" tag. The dark theme is carbon copy: charcoal sheets, dimmed stock tints, chalk-blue ink.

Density is moderate and task-first: paste, run, copy. Layouts survive Spanish copy lengths. Motion is short and ink-like (rise, stamp-in, stepped blink); reduced motion collapses it.
keyCharacteristics: Flat stock fields own whole regions; colour is paper, not gradient.
2-3px corners, 1px ink rules, perforation dashes, ruled typing lines.
Two faces: Public Sans prints, Courier Prime types.
Output tabs are sheet edges; each tab and its sheet share one stock colour.
Light and dark are both first-class.

rules.name: The Three Inks Rule
rules.body: Black prints, blue is typed, red is serial. Red never decorates; blue never labels.

rules.name: The Stock Rule
rules.body: A colour sheet is a flat unmodulated field. No gradients, no tints layered on tints; hierarchy comes from the rules and the tab edge.

rules.name: The Typed Content Rule
rules.body: Anything the applicant supplied or a machine counted (CV text, numbers, serials, dates) is Courier Prime with tabular figures; anything the form prints is Public Sans.

rules.name: The Stack Not Glow Rule
rules.body: Extra depth is another sheet behind, never a larger blur.

dos: Do colour whole output regions with one flat stock (white, canary, rose, sky) and keep tab and sheet the same colour.
Do set typed or counted content in Courier Prime with tabular figures.
Do keep one carbon-blue primary action per view.
Do make list items ledger rows with a typed serial and tabular figures.
Do keep placeholders and secondary text at muted ink (AA on sheet) in both themes.
Do keep keyword-coverage wording on the fit stamp.
donts: Don't use serial red for anything but serial numbers, stamps, the ink dot, destructive actions and the suggested tag.
Don't use gradients, glass, blurred shadows or blobs; the glass-blob dashboard is the rejected anti-reference.
Don't put big-number metric strips in place of ledger rows.
Don't theme or restyle the sandboxed styled-CV iframe.
